title: Get to know the 11 ASEAN member states
summary: (1st UPDATE) Here are some basic facts about the 11 countries belonging to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations

blocks.text: (1st UPDATE) Here are some basic facts about the 11 countries belonging to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations
Editor’s Note: This story was originally published on May 4, 2026, and republished with updates on November 13, 2026.
MANILA, Philippines – All eyes are on the Philippines as it takes on the role of chair of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) in 2026.
This places Manila at the forefront of coordinating priorities across Southeast Asia’s leading multilateral bloc, guiding discussions on regional cooperation, stability, and integration.

Established in 1967, ASEAN was formed to promote regional peace, political stability, and economic cooperation among Southeast Asian countries. The Philippines is one of the five founding members, along with Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand.
Who are the members of ASEAN today? Here are some basic information about the 11 countries.
